items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the topological space of a decent algebraic stack is Kolmogorov, that is, two points each specializing to the other must coincide (author lemma at source lines 10518-10523, label lemma-kolmogorov). The proof (source lines 10525-10557) reduces to the irreducible case through the decent reduced closed substack on the common closure, introduces a generic point of the space coming from a generic point of a component of a smooth presentation, and uses the specialization lifting lemma to force equality of generic points (proof lines 10525-10556). The reduction and the lifting of specializations through a presentation are the content. H3.
